text:
nina (partnerships): Big news 0 min heads-up - Citrine Systems is GA on IBM Cloud Catalog as an ISV listing! :confetti_ball: They've launched with a Dedicated + Private deployment option and an initial 3-month pilot (250k tokens/mo).
omar (sales): Fantastic. Shoutout to everyone. Who's drafting the external case study and exec quote?
tara (solutions): I can own the technical case study. Will include architecture diagram showing our VPC peering + KMS integration. Need log samples and perf traces from infra team.
raj (customer-success): I'll run kickoff with the Citrine team tomorrow. Need to confirm SLA expectations and FedRAMP posture for their gov customers.
zoe (marketing): I'll prepare an announcement plan: blog, 1-pager, and social. Can we get a short quote from Citrine's CTO and a screenshot of the dedicated dashboard?
ed (legal): All marketplace agreements finalized. Theres a clause for FedRAMP data handling and a minor IP appendix. CS to confirm controls mapping.
marketplace-bot: IBM catalog validation complete 0 manifest & entitlements OK, public visibility set to partner-only.
nina (partnerships): Next steps: (1) Tara to share draft case study by Mon EOD; (2) Raj to confirm FedRAMP items and kickoff time; (3) Zoe to prep announcement assets targeting two-week lead time.
omar (sales): I'll update the deal in CRM and set renewal reminders at month 9. Also adding upsell target for embeddings pilot.
tara (solutions): Quick FYI - early perf numbers show 22% CPU savings on our quantized runner at p50 for their NLU models. Sharing small table in a follow-up.
raj (customer-success): Citrine contacts: helen@citrine.ai and sam@citrine.ai. Proposed kickoff Wed 2pm ET.
zoe (marketing): If we get the CTO quote quickly I can land the blog the week after kickoff. Sending a draft tweet thread to the channel for review.
ed (legal): Raj, please log the FedRAMP item as open until controls mapping confirmed.
nina (partnerships): Amazing team effort 1 big thanks to Solutions, CS, Legal, and Marketing. Tagging @tara @raj @zoe to keep momentum. :rocket:
